name: Biorestaurant Garmischer Hof
kurzbeschreibung:
**Organic Restaurant Garmischer Hof in Garmisch-Partenkirchen** --- **

Tradition meets sustainability

** Welcome to the **Garmischer Hof**, a family-run restaurant nestled in the heart of **Garmisch-Partenkirchen**, where authentic Bavarian hospitality meets modern organic cuisine. Since 1926, we’ve been serving guests with passion—now with a focus on regional, seasonal, and sustainable ingredients. --- **

Our concept

** At **Garmischer Hof**, we believe in **good food, good people, and a good planet**. Our **Bio** kitchen is certified by **Demeter**, ensuring not only organic produce but also ethical farming practices. From our **Kaiserschmarrn** to our **Obazda** with fresh **Brezn**, every dish tells a story of **Tirol’s** rich culinary traditions—reimagined with care for the environment. --- **

Highlights

** - **Breakfast fit for kings**: Start your day with our famous **Garmischer Hof breakfast**, featuring homemade jams, fresh eggs from our **Demeter**-certified farm, and artisanal bread. - **Lunch specials**: Enjoy hearty **Tiroler Gröstl** or a light **Kürbissuppe**—all made with ingredients sourced from local farmers. - **Dinner with a view**: Savor our **Wildschweinbraten** (roast wild boar) or **Forellenfilet** (trout fillet) in our cozy dining room, overlooking the **Zugspitze**. - **Sweet indulgence**: End your meal with our **Apfelstrudel** or a slice of **Sachertorte**, baked with love and organic ingredients. --- **

More than just food

** We’re not just about eating—we’re about **experiencing**. Join our **cooking workshops** to learn how to prepare **Tiroler classics** like **Käsespätzle** or **Leberknödelsuppe**. Or relax in our **garden café**, where you can enjoy a **Eis** (ice cream) made with **Bio** milk and fresh berries from our garden. --- **

Visit us

We look forward to welcoming you—where tradition meets tomorrow’s sustainability!
